lines.text: Many learners say: I know swimming.
Better: I know how to swim.
How to! I know how to drive.

native.tip: Türkçede “yüzmeyi biliyorum” deriz; İngilizcede “know how to swim” denir: “I know how to swim.”
native.caption: “I know swimming” mi diyorsun? 😅 “Know” sözcüğünden sonra “how to” ve fiil gelir. Doğrusu “I know how to swim.” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “how to”. “Yüzmeyi biliyorum” için “I know how to swim” de. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: Put “how to” after “know”: “I know how to swim.”
en.caption: Do you say “I know swimming”? 😅 In English you need how to after know before another verb. The right sentence is “I know how to swim.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
